content:
In 1996 I attended the Health Educator Program which was the most life-changing, positive experience in my life. After graduation, a center here in eastern Canada asked me to teach courses on living food which slowly evolved to become my business "Power of Raw". Quarterly, once a month, I conduct hands-on classes on Friday evenings and all day Saturday. Hundreds of people have been through these many courses and, I am pleased to say, I have been fulfilled knowing that I can help people to help themselves. Those of you who have the motivation and energy to move forward in your life but need an immediate and positive change should join the ever increasing number of Hippocrates Educators worldwide.
